why: Replacing C8 made the model more willing to isolate sentence‑initial function words/discourse markers (it started cutting immediately after openers). That behaviour produced small gains for slightly longer remainders (≤10 bin) where the remainder stayed cohesive, but increased harmful fragmentation in the shortest latency bins (≤3/≤5/≤7) by introducing extra early cuts and splitting predicates/NPs (illustrated by the 'However, ‖ a nationwide…' and fragmented predicate examples), leaving the overall change near zero.
lesson: A later revision should respect that permitting isolation of sentence‑initial openers can help when the remainder is sufficiently long/cohesive (benefit in ≤10) but currently increases fragmentation in the very-short bins, so the change must not encourage immediate cuts after openers that produce very-short or predicate-splitting fragments.
